description: This file defines a class `RegexStreamNamespacePredicate` that implements the `IStreamNamespacePredicate` interface. It filters stream namespaces using a regular expression provided at instantiation. The class provides a pattern representation and a matching method.

classes.name: RegexStreamNamespacePredicate
classes.description: A predicate that filters stream namespaces based on a regular expression.

methods.name: PredicatePattern
methods.description: Returns the pattern used to describe this predicate, combining the 'regex:' prefix with the compiled regex.

methods.name: RegexStreamNamespacePredicate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the predicate with a specified regular expression.

methods.name: IsMatch
methods.description: Checks if the given stream namespace matches the regular expression.
